instruction: Run the tests as you patch one pattern and it passes move to next expand the 9 I like your plan and it will work well with a run of error patterns / fix sprints
scope: Freeze the original nine coordinator questions, excerpt locators and strict results.
Add bounded strict-reader coverage for recorded stage and open outcome, labeled item rows, permission qualifications, and explicit versus unsettled cause.
Rerun the unchanged nine between sprints and retain 28 expanded positive and negative controls and their prepatch failures.
validation: Each sprint passed its new matched controls before the next. The final nine ended at five full answers and four cited partial answers, up from nine abstentions.
All 28 matched controls and the two extra source-state and quoted-context checks passed. The focused deterministic regression run passed 102 tests.
Three newly acquired National Archives transcript excerpts remained abstentions on both revisions. The separate passage probe located all three excerpts.
limitations: New rules operate on small, complete source packets with explicitly supported source forms. The exploratory archival results show their present coverage limit.
The direct source comparisons use supplied excerpts and authored controls. Independent historical truth review and the proposed human pilot remain pending.
next_steps: Use a sealed reviewer-graded historical corpus to test extraction of qualified clauses out of broader prose while preserving ambiguity and contradiction checks.
